items.title: Define the milestone status report contract and data model
items.context: Add a machine-readable report model that projects milestone rows, subObjectives, evidence refs, risks, status transitions, and next actions from existing story facts. The report must be read-only and must not become a second milestone storage system.

happy.desc: A sample story with a milestone ledger renders a JSON report containing every milestone and sub-objective row.

edge.desc: A story without a ledger returns a clear missing-ledger blocker and next action instead of pretending progress is complete.

adversarial.desc: Passing runCommands/writeEvidence/advancePhase-like options must fail closed or be unavailable; the status command must not mutate story state.

items.userSees: User sees JSON fields exactly like "schemaVersion", "storyId", "groups", "milestones", "subObjectives", "evidenceRefs", "risks", "nextActions", and "readOnly": true.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused test builds a sample confirmed milestone ledger and asserts JSON report fields include every milestone, groups, subObjectives, evidenceRefs, risks, nextActions, and readOnly mode.

Focused test covers missing milestoneLedger=null and asserts ledger.present=false, completed/current/remaining groups are empty, a missing-ledger blocker is reported, and next action points to milestone_ledger_set.
Focused test calls the handler with runCommands=true against a fake store and verifies it throws before any store read, preserving the read-only boundary.

items.title: Add the read-only milestone_status CLI command
items.context: Expose lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-xxxx with text and JSON output. The text view must group completed milestones first, current milestone in the middle with expanded sub-objectives, and remaining milestones below.

happy.desc: lattice milestone_status --storyId=<story> prints a grouped progress table with status, evidence, and next action columns.

edge.desc: Text output remains useful when subObjectives are absent by falling back to checklist refs and requiredEvidence hints.

adversarial.desc: The command must reject mutation flags and must not write evidence, phase changes, review passes, summaries, or milestone ledger files.

items.userSees: User sees text headings exactly like "Milestone Status - B-demo", "Mode: read-only", "Completed", "Current", and "Remaining".

items.title: Project completion and verification detail into milestone rows
items.context: Join milestone ledger rows with checklist statuses, verificationIntent, verificationEvidence, validation summary, and summary_set where available so the user can see what changed from which state to which state, evidence, risks, and next step.

happy.desc: A milestone with completed checklist refs and evidence appears completed with evidence refs and no blocking next action.

edge.desc: A partially complete milestone appears current or in_progress with remaining sub-objectives and the smallest next action.

adversarial.desc: A stale or missing evidence-like row must not be reported as DONE merely because checklist text says completed.

items.userSees: User sees row details exactly like "Status:", "Sub-objectives:", "Evidence:", "Risks:", and "Next action:" for the current milestone.

items.title: Document and test the grouped progress reporting workflow
items.context: Add tests and documentation showing how hosts should print the full table after each milestone or sub-objective status change, at handoff, and in final responses.

happy.desc: Automated tests cover JSON shape, grouped text rendering, and missing-ledger behavior.

edge.desc: Docs explain prerequisites: milestone ledger granularity determines available detail; completion/executor ledgers improve future detail but are not required for V1.

adversarial.desc: Docs must not claim automatic execution, automatic DONE, Authority completion, or production readiness.

items.userSees: User sees docs and tests name "lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-demo", "read-only", "no automatic execution", and "no production readiness claim".
